about: Limits and warning thresholds for the autosuggest exclusion change plan. scripts/exclusion_plan.py reads this file; SKILL.md names the keys rather than repeating the numbers. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.max_changes_per_batch: The most changes shown for one yes. Larger plans are split into several batches, each confirmed on its own.
notes.max_keywords_per_rule: The most keywords one exclusion rule can hold (the write tools cap the list at this). Larger sets of new keywords are split across several new rules.
notes.max_text_chars: The longest rule name or note the write tools accept. Longer ones are cut, with a warning.
notes.min_keyword_chars: A keyword shorter than this gets a warning: very short suggestions are often legitimate (sizes, brand initials).
notes.warn_sessions: Excluding a keyword that is itself a search with at least this many sessions in the query performance data is a high-priority warning: it hides a query shoppers really use.
notes.warn_revenue: Excluding a keyword that is itself a search with at least this much revenue (in the account's currency) is a high-priority warning.
notes.word_match_warn_count: A one-word keyword that appears as a word in at least this many top queries or current suggestions gets a warning to check after sync, in case the exclusion hides more than the exact suggestion.
notes.default_rule_name: The name given to new exclusion rules when the request doesn't name one. A number is added when the keywords need more than one rule.
